title: When Does $N$ Buy Precision? Heterogeneous Responses to Aggregate Shocks in Micro Panels
abstract: arXiv:2611.00677v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Panel local projections (panel LPs), valued for their flexibility and robustness, are widely used to estimate heterogeneous responses to aggregate shocks from micro data. This paper, however, highlights the potential of panel vector autoregressions (panel VARs) and characterizes the trade-off between the efficiency of panel VARs and the robustness of panel LPs. In contrast to existing results in the time-series literature, we show that under correct specification, panel VAR estimators of the heterogeneous responses converge at rate $(NT)^{-1/2}$, whereas panel LP estimators converge at rate $T^{-1/2}$. When the heterogeneous response function is nonparametric, the panel VAR incurs a nonparametric rate loss, whereas the panel LP retains its parametric $T^{-1/2}$ rate under suitable smoothness and panel-growth conditions. We provide a Hausman-type test for choosing between them, with power against two forms of panel VAR misspecification. W

translated_title: N 何时能换来精度？微观面板中对总量冲击的异质性响应
translated_abstract: 面板局部投影（panel LPs）因其灵活性和稳健性，被广泛用于从微观数据中估计经济主体对总量冲击的异质性响应。然而，本文凸显了面板向量自回归（panel VARs）的潜力，并刻画了面板 VAR 的有效性与面板 LP 的稳健性之间的权衡。与时序文献中的既有结论不同，我们证明在模型设定正确的情况下，异质性响应的面板 VAR 估计量以 $(NT)^{-1/2}$ 的速度收敛，而面板 LP 估计量仅以 $T^{-1/2}$ 的速度收敛。当异质性响应函数为非参数形式时，面板 VAR 会遭受非参数收敛速度的损失，而在适当的平滑性与面板增长条件下，面板 LP 仍能保持参数化的 $T^{-1/2}$ 收敛速度。我们还提供了一种 Hausman 型检验，用于在两种方法之间进行选择，该检验对两种形式的面板 VAR 误设具有检验功效。
tldr: 本文刻画了面板 VAR 与面板 LP 在估计微观面板对总量冲击异质性响应时的效率-稳健性权衡——正确设定下面板 VAR 以 $(NT)^{-1/2}$ 速度收敛而面板 LP 仅以 $T^{-1/2}$ 速度收敛——并提供了一种在两者之间进行选择的 Hausman 型检验。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the efficiency-robustness trade-off between panel VARs and panel LPs for estimating heterogeneous responses to aggregate shocks—showing that under correct specification panel VARs converge at rate $(NT)^{-1/2}$ while panel LPs converge at $T^{-1/2}$—and proposes a Hausman-type test for choosing between the two methods.
